# Did your landlord bill the right percentage rent?

> Free tool for retail and restaurant tenants: recompute your landlord's percentage rent statement from your lease breakpoint, exclusions and your own sales, see the overcharge in dollars, and copy a dispute note.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
